evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 and echoed dueDate "2026-10-14", a date with no time. POST with no dueDate returned 201 and the todo has no dueDate field.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-01-05"} returned 200 and the todo now had that dueDate. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and the dueDate field was gone. A following GET /todos/4 confirmed it stayed removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "15.10.2026" returned 400. POST with "2026-10-15T10:00:00Z" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 UTC. I created todos with due dates of yesterday, today and a future date, one with no due date, and one done todo with a past due date. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the yesterday todo. When todo 4 was temporarily given a past due date it was returned as well. After its dueDate was removed it was not returned. The today, future, no-date and done-past todos were never returned.
evidence.AC5: Loaded / in the browser. Todos with a due date show it, e.g. "past fällig: 14.10.2026", "today fällig: 15.10.2026" and "future fällig: 01.12.2026". The todo without a due date shows none.
evidence.AC6: In the list, only "past" (due yesterday, not done) shows the word "überfällig". "today", "future", "nodate" and "donepast ✓" (done, past due date) do not show it.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Clicking it reduced the list to the single item "past fällig: 14.10.2026 überfällig".
